mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,request_id,shop_number,coupon_template_id,source,receive_count,template_snapshot,status,retry_at, attempts,worker_id,lease_until,last_error,create_time,update_time FROM t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox WHERE status='NEW' OR (status='RETRY' AND retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id,user_id,request_id,shop_number,coupon_template_id,source,receive_count,template_snapshot,status,retry_at, attempts,worker_id,lease_until,last_error,create_time,update_time FROM t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox WHERE status='PUBLISHED' AND retry_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id,user_id,request_id,shop_number,coupon_template_id,source,receive_count,template_snapshot,status,retry_at, attempts,worker_id,lease_until,last_error,create_time,update_time FROM t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox WHERE status='INIT' AND create_time <= #{now} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox SET status='NEW',receive_count=#{receiveCount},retry_at=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='INIT'
UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox SET status='FAILED',last_error=#{lastError},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='INIT'
UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',worker_id=#{workerId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')
UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox SET status='RETRY',retry_at=#{now},worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now}

UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',retry_at=#{nextCheckAt},worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='PROCESSING' AND worker_id=#{workerId}
UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox SET status='DONE',worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('PROCESSING','PUBLISHED')
UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox SET status='RETRY',retry_at=#{retryAt},worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='PUBLISHED'
UPDATE t_user_coupon_redeem_outbox SET retry_at=#{nextCheckAt},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='PUBLISHED'
